leaders.name: Florida Man
leaders.passive: Once each round after one of your Units attacks, another ready Unit you control gets +1 Power this round.

active.text: Dismiss an Item you control. A Unit you control gets +2 Power this round.

leaders.name: Little League Coach
leaders.passive: The first time each round you deploy a Unit costing 3 or more, it gets +1 Guard this round.

active.text: Choose a Unit you control. It gets +1 Power and +1 Guard this round.

leaders.name: ROOT
leaders.passive: The first time each round you play an Action that targets an enemy Unit, that Unit gets -1 Power this round.

active.text: Ready one of your exhausted Units.

leaders.name: Trash Baron
leaders.passive: The first time each round you Repurpose a card, gain 1 temporary resource that may only be spent on a Makeshift card or Item this round.

active.text: Repurpose a card from your discard. This does not count against your normal once-per-round Repurpose.

leaders.name: HOA President
leaders.passive: The first Unit you control that blocks each round gets +3 Guard this round.

active.text: Choose an enemy Unit. It gets -1 Power this round.

leaders.name: Backyard Wrestler
leaders.passive: The first time each round one of your Units dies during combat, another Unit you control gets +1 Power this round.

active.text: Choose a damaged Unit you control. It gets +2 Power this round. If it dies this round, draw a card.
